decisions.rationale: Peerless Fence is an SMB operating brand within a PE-backed platform (Elevate Fence Partners). The integration scope spans 6+ systems (HD Portal, Salesforce, ComputerEase, DocHub, GCP, Deltek) with heavy manual data entry and no evidence of in-house MuleSoft development capability. IaaS model with managed connectors and pre-built templates will accelerate time-to-value and reduce operational overhead for this resource-constrained team.
